assumptions.statement: Official boundaries, regulatory controls, road redlines, ownership, municipal utilities, heritage controls and engineering constraints are unavailable.
assumptions.impact: All parcel, intensity, height, demolition, engineering and implementation statements remain conceptual recommendations.

assumptions.statement: The submission uses repository provisional polygons for intake and recomputation.
assumptions.impact: Official polygons require full regeneration of geometry, metrics, figures, PDFs, HTML and manifest.

assumptions.statement: Per open Issue #1029, the provisional Dazhongsi key-area rectangle is not anchored to Dazhongsi station/roads and currently falls near Beijing North Railway Station.
assumptions.impact: Do not infer station interfaces or parcel-level conclusions from PROV-KEY-003; retain source geometry and recompute when official data arrives.

assumptions.statement: No cleared nighttime inventory of luminaires, illuminance, luminance, glare, color temperature, energy or ecological receptors is available.
assumptions.impact: No numeric lighting target or saving claim is made; professional survey and applicable standards must set values.

assumptions.statement: Global cases are used to compare mechanisms, not to transfer performance claims or planning controls.
assumptions.impact: Every local application requires site-specific governance, engineering and public review.

assumptions.statement: Night scenarios default to no facial recognition and no persistent personal tracking.
assumptions.impact: Any future high-impact data use requires separate legal, ethical and public review.
